events.title: Mass wedding held in Nigeria sees 1500 couples tie the knot
events.summary: A mass wedding ceremony was held in Kano state on August 7, 2026, where 1500 couples, including widows and young women, were married in a state-sponsored event coordinated by the Kano State Hisbah Board. Each bride received a dowry of 200,000 naira and household items to support their new family life.
